Attached: 1 image

Human vs AI poetry. Scholars compared a 1917 avant-garde poem with neural-net-generated verse. The AI text had local coherence but no global meaning. The human text, despite being "difficult," was interpretable. Key insight: the "feeling" of meaning may come from the reader, not the text. What happens to poetry when machines learn to speak in verse?
